description: This Java source file defines the MockCluster class, which simulates a Zigbee cluster for testing or mock purposes within a Zigbee environment. It manages attributes, reporting configurations, and command handling for a Zigbee cluster, and includes mechanisms for reading and writing attributes, handling commands, and tracking reporting configs.

classes.name: MockCluster
classes.description: Represents a mock Zigbee cluster used for testing purposes, providing methods to read/write attributes, handle commands, and manage reporting configurations.

classes.name: MockCluster.DataType
classes.description: A static inner class defining various data type constants used in attribute data within the cluster.

methods.name: getClusterName
methods.description: Returns the name of the cluster.

methods.name: getEui64
methods.description: Returns the EUI64 identifier of the device.

methods.name: getEndpointId
methods.description: Returns the endpoint ID of the cluster.

methods.name: getClusterId
methods.description: Returns the cluster ID.

methods.name: isServer
methods.description: Indicates whether the cluster acts as a server.

methods.name: readAttribute
methods.description: Reads the value of an attribute by its ID.

methods.name: readMfgAttribute
methods.description: Reads a manufacturer-specific attribute by its manufacturer ID and attribute ID.

methods.name: writeAttribute
methods.description: Writes data to an attribute.

methods.name: getAttributeData
methods.description: Protected method to retrieve attribute data bytes; meant to be overridden.

methods.name: setAttributeData
methods.description: Protected method to set attribute data; meant to be overridden.

methods.name: addAttribute
methods.description: Adds an attribute with the specified ID and type to the cluster.

methods.name: addMfgAttribute
methods.description: Adds a manufacturer-specific attribute.

methods.name: getAttributeInfo
methods.description: Retrieves attribute info by attribute ID.

methods.name: getMfgAttributeInfo
methods.description: Retrieves manufacturer-specific attribute info.

methods.name: getAttributeInfos
methods.description: Returns all attribute infos for a given manufacturer ID.

methods.name: getAttributeBytes
methods.description: Converts a string into a length-prefixed byte array.

methods.name: handleCommand
methods.description: Handles an unprocessed command with its ID and payload.

methods.name: handleMfgCommand
methods.description: Handles a manufacturer-specific command and notifies waits.

methods.name: getMfgCommandWait
methods.description: Returns an EventWaitHelper for waiting on a specific manufacturer command.

methods.name: addReportingConfigs
methods.description: Adds reporting configurations for attributes.

methods.name: getReportingConfigs
methods.description: Retrieves all reporting configurations.

methods.name: getReportingConfig
methods.description: Retrieves a specific reporting config by attribute ID.

methods.name: notifyMfgCommandWait
methods.description: Notifies waiters for a manufacturer command.

methods.name: sendAttributeReport
methods.description: Sends an attribute report for a specific attribute ID.

methods.name: sendMfgAttributeReport
methods.description: Sends a manufacturer-specific attribute report.
